"What is the purpose of Knowledge? and How we Learn and Understand." There are 3 Fundamental sources of Domains of knowledge. These Domains exhibit specific kinds of Knowledge (according to Education-Theory) These domains include: Methodical, Implemented and Composed.

Methodoical knowledge is trait information; Textbooks, Libraries and Repositories serving as sources of recorded knowledge. However, this 'front-facing' sphere of knowledge is only one facet of the complex Domains of Human-Knowledge.

These Domains of knowledge help us further understand how exactly we understand anything; how we learn. We can then approach classes of problems through the lens of Knowledge Domains.
